packet.model_contract: Sales are same-quarter prior-year net_sales*(1+sales_growth). Operating income=sales*(gross_margin-sga_ratio); pretax=operating+net_nonoperating_income; attributable net income=pretax*(1-effective_tax_rate)-noncontrolling_income; EPS=attributable NI/diluted shares. OCF=total net income*ocf_to_net_income; capex=sales*capex_ratio, positive outflow. Historical diluted shares may be approximated by NI attributable/diluted EPS; disclose rounding. Gross margin and SG&A are fractions of sales. Noncontrolling interest=total NI-NI attributable. Net nonoperating=interest_income+signed interest_expense+other_income. Cash conversion and capex require seasonality caveats; no debt/cash bridge or operational units/headcount forecast is supported.
packet.analysis_scope: Analyst-defined illustrative scenario model, not official company budget. Derive defensible base from eligible history; bear/bull are adverse/favorable profitability scenarios, not numeric ascending for every driver. Contract bounds are broad guardrails, not prescribed forecast estimates. All market-to-financial mappings are analyst judgments. Finance should map only financially material reference rows (latest history, same-quarter-prior-year baseline, and supporting trends), not repeat every row. No final-period outcomes are supplied. Missing detailed cash, debt, exposure, or portfolio breakdowns must be limitations, not invented observed facts. QA evaluates a transparent illustrative model; uncertainty alone is not an error, but unsupported claims of certainty are.

limitations: Used only the supplied JSON; source excerpts and classifications were not independently verified. No remembered target results were used.
All supplied publications precede the 2026-03-31 information cutoff. Latest supplied history is fiscal Q2 2026; no target-period outcomes are supplied.
Mappings are historical references for an illustrative scenario model, not official guidance or forecast estimates. Contract bounds do not establish scenario values.
Financial statement amounts are USD million, EPS is USD/share, and approximate diluted shares are million shares. Percentage inputs are converted to decimals.
Reported earnings are retained without core/non-GAAP adjustments. No adjustment reconciliation is supplied; organic sales growth is distinct from reported sales growth.

Quarterly cash conversion and capital spending are seasonal references and are not annualized. Detailed cash, debt, working-capital, exposure, portfolio, operational-unit and headcount support is absent.
Derived ratios are rounded. Diluted shares inferred from attributable earnings divided by rounded EPS may differ from actual weighted-average diluted shares.
